career_ladder.note: Scientist 'B' is the premier direct entry cadre for engineers and scientists in the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), statutory national standards body under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution. Scientists in BIS formulate Indian Standards (IS), conduct laboratory testing and factory audits for ISI Mark / Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) conformity certification, represent India at ISO/IEC international technical committees, and steer national quality infrastructure missions. Promotions are governed by the Modified Flexible Complementing Scheme (FCS), which provides merit-based, time-bound advancement independent of vacancy constraints.

steps.years: Entry Grade (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500), Group A Gazetted (probation 2 years)
approx. 4 years (Promoted via Flexible Complementing Scheme assessment)

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment of Scientist 'B' is conducted based on valid GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) Score in corresponding engineering disciplines (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Metallurgical, Computer Engineering, Environmental Engineering) followed by a Personal Interview. Shortlisted candidates are called in the ratio of 1:4 per vacancy.

stages.source_label: BIS Notification for Recruitment of Scientist 'B'

papers.paper_name: GATE Examination in Relevant Engineering Discipline (Normalized Score out of 1000)
papers.negative_marking: Standard GATE negative marking (-0.33 for 1-mark MCQs, -0.66 for 2-mark MCQs)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Valid GATE scorecard required; candidates shortlisted in 1:4 ratio per vacancy; carries 85% weightage in final composite merit

stages.source_label: BIS Selection Board Interview Process for Scientist 'B'

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (Technical Domain Knowledge, Research Aptitude & Problem Solving)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (Assesses engineering fundamentals, standardization ethics, and communication)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 50% marks in interview for UR/EWS/OBC and 40% for SC/ST; carries 15% weightage in final composite merit

financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500) for Scientist 'B' (Group A Gazetted)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹56,100. Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% equals ₹32,538. House Rent Allowance ranges from ₹5,610 (10% in Z-class cities) to ₹16,830 (30% in X-class cities like New Delhi Headquarters). Transport Allowance is ₹11,376 (₹7,200 + 58% DA in higher TPTA cities) or ₹5,688 (other). Deductions include NPS 10% (Basic + DA = ₹8,864), medical scheme, and income tax.
official_perks: Group 'A' Central Officer Gazetted rank with time-bound promotion under Flexible Complementing Scheme (FCS)
Official residential quarters in BIS residential complexes / GPRA Type-V accommodation or 30% HRA
Comprehensive medical treatment and inpatient coverage under BIS Medical Attendance Rules
Professional Update Allowance and reimbursement of annual membership in international technical bodies (ISO/IEC/IEEE)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC), annual casual/earned leave, and child care leave
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% government contribution and central gratuity
